title: Bringing the music of the Americas to the cathedral.
body: Adán conducts and programs sacred music from across Latin America, from colonial-era villancicos to living composers, alongside the European repertoire. He has lectured on it in Colombia, London, and Canada, publishes on it with GIA and the Hymn Society, and edits Puentes for the Center for Congregational Song.
